periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented diagonally, approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a significantly elongated vertical-to-horizontal axis ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop-shaped inferior boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse band displays a wide, shallow U-shape profile across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band exhibits high relative thickness, covering approximately 40 percent of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal spacing between ears, exceeding the lateral width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature along the superior boundaries of both visible ears.
